scientific_limitations: Covers the complete operator-rank spectrum of derivations only for the six-dimensional total-degree cubic quotient in two variables; does not classify conjugacy/Jordan types, other nilpotence orders, or arbitrary Artinian algebras. title: Derivation-rank spectra of the two-variable quadratic jet algebra
